intro.text: ADARx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a late-clinical stage biotechnology company focused on developing next-generation RNA therapeutics designed to treat a broad spectrum of diseases. The Company is focused on advancing and expanding its pipeline of highly potent, selective and durable small interfering RNA (“siRNA”) therapeutic candidates, including three clinical-stage programs and two advanced preclinical programs. ADARx’s three hepatic-targeted programs are agazisiran, onvuzosiran and ADX-626, and its two extrahepatic-targeted programs are ADX-077 and ADX-199. Beyond its named programs, ADARx plans to continue to leverage its proprietary technologies to strategically expand its pipeline of next-generation siRNA therapeutics.
